from app.api.handlers import handle_user_report

def test_handle_user_report_valid():
    params = {"name": "test-user_123"}
    code, report = handle_user_report(params)
    assert code == 200
    assert report["name"] == "test-user_123"
    assert "checksum" in report

def test_handle_user_report_invalid_name():
    # Too long
    assert handle_user_report({"name": "a" * 33}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
    # Invalid characters
    assert handle_user_report({"name": "user!"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
    # Not a string
    assert handle_user_report({"name": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
    # Missing
    assert handle_user_report({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})

EOF
